task_definition.task_description: Please scan the devices in my living room, then restart the living room light and, after it comes back, turn it on at 75% brightness. After that, save a snapshot of its workspace and send me a medium-priority app alert, then create a medium-priority reminder for 2026-01-15 19:30 with the title “Reminder 1” and the description “Notification sent successfully.”

user_input.query: Please scan the devices in my living_room, then restart the light with device ID light_living. Once it’s back online, set its power_state to on and adjust the brightness to 75%. After that, save a snapshot of its workspace at /ops/iot/light_living and send me a medium-priority app alert for user_123. Then create a medium-priority reminder for 2026-01-15 19:30 titled “Reminder 1” with the description “Notification sent successfully.”
user_input.title: Reminder 1
